== English Death Star II comparison ==
The announcement and current D-E1 permit Covert Landing while landed. The announcement, 2017 slip and 2021–23 Appendices omit the explicit docking sentence, while 2016 Appendix p.105 retains it. Both states print Capital: Modified Transport, so general rules supply the same docking ability. Preserve the exact 2016 full-wording variant in source evidence. A third gameplay column would duplicate the dated replacement's rules effect. Keep the two changed printed phrases visible where relevant and explain the supplied capability. The 2016 wording retains the explicit docking sentence. Under the general rules the capital ship has docking in both wordings.
